svg.text: The build is verified at every level
Colony PCR, junction PCR and a diagnostic digest — our own gels
Every lane carries the band — what a colony count alone cannot show.
Three independent clones across three junctions; EcoRI linearises the Level 2 construct at the expected size and EcoRI+BtsI cuts it as designed.
No Level 2 construct has been sequenced end to end — say so if asked.
